banner.title: ALTERING FAMILY HONOR, THE EFFECTS OF HONOR AND TABLE 42, printed capture pp. 70-72 - the OA effects of honor round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture alone for this range (the settling authority): the first Mistral-OCR capture session is unavailable above p. 33, so the cross-capture agreement check is impossible. No contested cells detected within the single source: the T42 grid pins as 68 rows x 2 columns across the ten printed sections (all characters, shukenja, hengeyokai, kensai, ninja, samurai, sohei, spirit folk, wu jen, yakuza); the points column carries every printed award and the mark column codes the printed footnotes (0 unmarked, 1 the samurai-doubled star, 2 the single-creature double star). The two rate rows pin as per-unit consts - the monsters row -1 per 2000 experience points for a single creature, the yakuza stolen-goods row +1 per 100 ch'ien - with the base points in the grid. OCR normalization: the double-star footnote reads "defeating a single-creature" with a printed em dash (pins as single-creature); the awards use the printed x.p. abbreviation. The Chapter 5 Money and Equipment prose (capture pp. 73+) is deliberately left for the next rounds
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 80 closed, 155 open - the Altering Family Honor, Effects of Honor prose, Table 42 and the Chapter 4 parent boxes flip (census 557 -> 558); NEXT - R636: the Chapter 5 Money and Equipment opener, the Currency prose with Table 43 (Currency Values) and Table 44 (Barter Units), capture pp. 73-75, prefix dgw (verify free), audit "R636 OA money audit", include after rules/oaeff.h

consts.name: dgvFamilyRaiseStep

consts.name: dgvFamilyRaiseAmount
consts.comment: Altering family honor prose (capture p. 70): the family base honor raise per step, also at 20, 30, 40 and so on

consts.name: dgvFamilyLossThreshold
consts.comment: Altering family honor prose (capture p. 70): the single-action loss that blots the family - five or more points

consts.name: dgvFamilyLossAmount
consts.comment: Altering family honor prose (capture p. 70): the family base honor loss for the blot

consts.name: dgvBelowBaseModPct
consts.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): the reaction modifier below the family or class base, -20 percent with the family members

consts.name: dgvAboveBaseBonusPct
consts.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): the reaction bonus per 10 points above the base, +5 percent

consts.name: dgvGiftHonorPoints
consts.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): the gift from a powerful lord at 75 honor points

consts.name: dgvSongsHonorPoints
consts.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): the songs and stories at 80 honor points

consts.name: dgvServeHonorPoints
consts.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): the invitation to serve a great lord at 90 honor points

consts.name: dgvGreatHeroHonorPoints
consts.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): the great hero at 95 honor points

consts.name: dgvFoeBoastPct
consts.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): the 10 percent weekly chance of the notorious foe boasting

consts.name: dgvFoeRefuseHonorLoss
consts.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): the honor loss for refusing to seek out the boasting foe

consts.name: dgvServeRefusePct
consts.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): the refusal penalty with the lord and his followers, -10 percent

consts.name: dgvGreatHeroBonusPct
consts.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): the +10 percent bonus with lesser rank, the -10 percent penalty with the opposite alignment

consts.name: dgvSuccessorDivisor
consts.comment: The final benefit prose (capture p. 72): the death-honor remainder divided by 10, fractions rounded down

consts.name: dgvSuccessorMaxPerRoll
consts.comment: The final benefit prose (capture p. 72): no more than three points on any single roll

consts.name: dgvMonsterXpPerPoint
consts.comment: T42 monsters row (capture p. 72): the honor loss per 2000 experience points, single creatures only

consts.name: dgvStolenChienPerPoint
consts.comment: T42 yakuza row (capture p. 72): the honor gain per 100 ch'ien of stolen goods

bools.name: dgvClanFortunesFollow
bools.comment: Altering family honor prose (capture p. 70): noble, heroic and successful characters elevate the family name while craven, lying and treacherous characters drag it down

bools.name: dgvRaiseOncePerGroup
bools.comment: Altering family honor prose (capture p. 70): the family raise is earned only once for each group of 10 points

bools.name: dgvRaiseAtMaxHonor
bools.comment: Altering family honor prose (capture p. 70): the bonus can be earned even at the honor maximum - the character has reached his pinnacle but his deeds still reflect well upon the clan

bools.name: dgvLossBlotsFamily
bools.comment: Altering family honor prose (capture p. 70): losing five or more points for a single action is a lasting blot on the family name

bools.name: dgvFamilyShareChange
bools.comment: Altering family honor prose (capture p. 70): when a character changes the family honor, all other family members change by the same amount - family members affect each other

bools.name: dgvEffectsAutomatic
bools.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): the advantages and disadvantages automatically come into play as honor is gained and lost

bools.name: dgvBelowZeroOut
bools.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): honor below zero means the character is out of the game - the record sheet is crumpled up and tossed away

bools.name: dgvSamuraiKensaiStatus
bools.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): a samurai or kensai whose honor falls below the family base loses his status - the samurai becomes a ronin and the kensai is treated as a bushi

bools.name: dgvBelowBaseFamilyMod
bools.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): any class below the family honor or the class base takes the -20 percent family modifier until the honor again equals or exceeds the base

bools.name: dgvHarderToImpress
bools.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): every 10 points above the base gives the +5 percent bonus, but the family or group honor also rises - it becomes harder and harder to impress them

bools.name: dgvGiftFromLord
bools.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): the 75-point gift is appropriate to the level and class, never a threat to the lord, and the player character is expected to return the compliment

bools.name: dgvSongsAndBoasts
bools.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): at 80 points the name appears in songs and stories; the notorious foe boasts reach the character's ears automatically

bools.name: dgvLordInvitation
bools.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): at 90 points the character is invited to serve one of the most powerful lords - under no obligation, but refusal angers the lord

bools.name: dgvGreatHeroRead
bools.comment: Effects of honor prose (capture pp. 71-72): at 95 points the great hero gains the +10 percent bonus with lesser rank and the -10 percent penalty with opposite alignment or belief - friends treat him with respect, enemies hate him more

bools.name: dgvSuccessorBonus
bools.comment: The final benefit prose (capture p. 72): a character who dies and is not returned to play grants the next character bonus points - the death honor above the base, divided by 10 rounded down, added to ability or hit point dice rolls

bools.name: dgvSuccessorLimits
bools.comment: The final benefit prose (capture p. 72): the bonus cannot raise a roll above the racial or class maximum and cannot be saved for later in the career

bools.name: dgvSuccessorFreedom
bools.comment: The final benefit prose (capture p. 72): the created character can be of any race, class or family, meeting the ability requirements normally

bools.name: dgvKensaiDuelOncePerLevel
bools.comment: T42 kensai prose (capture p. 72): duel awards are given only for fighting a particular NPC once per level - a second duel has no effect until the character advances

bools.name: dgvSamuraiDoubleAwards
bools.comment: T42 footnote (capture p. 72): the starred awards are doubled for samurai characters

bools.name: dgvSingleCreatureRead
bools.comment: T42 footnote (capture p. 72): the monsters award applies only to points earned for defeating a single creature
